# Mutation-testing tools — kept apart from requirements-dev.txt on purpose.
#
# mutmut drags in libcst, textual and rich: ~20 packages, several with compiled
# wheels. The lint, coverage and workflow-lint jobs run on every push and have no
# use for any of it, so they install the three tools they need and nothing more.
# This file is pulled by one workflow, once a week.
#
# Same rule as the dev set: hash-pinned, generated, never typed.
#   python scripts/pin_dev_deps.py <name==version ...> > requirements-mutation.txt
# The list below is the full transitive closure, resolved with
#   pip install --dry-run --report ... mutmut==3.7.0 pytest coverage==7.13.4
# `coverage` is pinned to the version requirements-dev.txt uses: one number for the
# repo, not one per workflow.
